rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: The Official Gazette special extra issue No. 9 (号外特第9号) dated Wednesday 18 February 2026 (発行 内閣府) prints under 人事異動 / 内閣 the appointment of 高市早苗 as Prime Minister (内閣総理大臣に任命する), followed by the appointments of the ministers of state.

locator.item: 内閣総理大臣に任命する

rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: Page 2 of the same issue closes the day's appointments with (以上二月十八日) and, under ○内閣総理大臣及び国務大臣退官, states that, 高市早苗 having been appointed Prime Minister on the 18th of that month (本月十八日), 高市早苗, Prime Minister of the first Takaichi cabinet (第一次高市内閣の内閣総理大臣高市早苗), and the ministers of state each lost their office (それぞれその地位を失った).
